reverie.title: Reverie
reverie.alt: A dark-haired woman rests her head on her drawn-up knee, gazing at a candle trailing smoke beside her.

soulbreak.title: Soulbreak
soulbreak.alt: A figure arches backwards, pierced by a shaft of white light, her head half seared off. She's surrounded by billowing clouds of fire and smoke, and behind her on the ground where the light lands, a phoenix rises.

samhain.title: Samhain
samhain.alt: Against deep red, the top half of a woman floats in shades of pale green and white. Her eyes are closed and her face is turned up; she appears to be dancing, an ankh necklace hanging from her wrist. A red sickle moon appears on her forehead. Below is a stone circle, its centre billowing smoke in spirals.

revelation.title: Revelation
revelation.alt: A long-haired figure gazes upward, flanked by reaching hands, one deathly and one living. They look up at light bursting between a blue skull and a red, fiery face. On the side of death, a skeleton steers a boat through the Styx, and on the right rivers of lava run past volcanoes.

omnibeat.title: Omnibeat
omnibeat.alt: A giant pale figure with pointed ears and branches growing from her head reaches towards the sun, a full moon floating behind her other hand. At her feet are mountains, a river running through them.

albedo.title: Albedo
albedo.alt: A pale silver figure stands in dark water, her head fading into the eclipsed moon, and a yew tree sprouting from parts of her body. A snake coils around her and she points a paintbrush towards a yoni symbol glowing on her chest. A golden phoenix with eye-marked tail feathers perches on a branch growing from her stomach.

ponyland.title: Ponyland
ponyland.alt: A wide night scene around a glowing fiery lotus, with red and blue faces in the background of a tree and clouds turning into horse spirits.

renaissance.title: Renaissance
renaissance.alt: A nude woman dances through swirling magenta and gold, one arm holding a paintbrush stretched up towards a dark butterfly. A tree, flower petals and snake skin grow from her, and she pierces a smaller figure through with a spear topped with a pinecone. A phoenix flies in the distance, and a peacock feather floats from the right.

root-and-branch.title: Root and Branch
root-and-branch.alt: A tree reaches towards a starlit sky, an orange glow of the sunset still visible over the forest beyond. In the roots, sad figures huddle or push one another away; in the central trunk a woman holds a crying man, and in the branches happy figures dance, play and embrace.

emerge.title: Emerge
emerge.alt: A blonde woman with her eyes closed tilts her face upward, a colourful butterfly at her brow, a daisy behind her ear and red butterflies circling behind.

in-their-arms.title: In Their Arms
in-their-arms.alt: A nude figure lies curled and sleeping among snow-capped mountain peaks at sunset, her body merging with the rock. Her tears have slid down her arm, dripping into a glacier at a lake. A bird wheels over the waters.

web-of-being.title: Web of Being
web-of-being.alt: A face surfaces from a violet web of mycelium threads, with mushrooms and fungi growing out of the strands around it. Her gaze is fixed on a ladybird on a nearby mushroom.

world-to-come.title: World to Come
world-to-come.alt: A woman crouches in a forest clearing, a jug at her side and a bloodied spear behind her. A scar is visible on her chest as she looks up at the shooting stars overhead – sperm-shaped, falling towards her. She points a paintbrush at a fire emerging from her vulva.

earthborn.title: Earthborn
earthborn.alt: A red-haired figure lies on her stomach in a dark, misty forest, cupping a small glowing golden face she has dug from the earth. Rays of light filled with eyes shine out from the golden face, and a crow and snake look on.
